content: Sender-receiver communication for IOControls is limited to atomic S/R interfaces If a DID has a configured DcmDspDidUsePort = USE_DATA_ELEMENT_SPECIFIC_INTERFACES , the possible values of DcmDsp- DataUsePort are limited to non S/R interfaces.
